list.name: go_live
list.definition: SELECT COALESCE(to_char(go_live AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') || ' UTC', '(no data yet)') FROM data_since
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(to_char(go_live AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') || ' UTC', '(no data yet)') FROM data_since

options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no earlier data. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Most popular international routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 45. Top 10 departure-arrival pairs where either end is outside the home region (home prefixes from app_setting home_icao_prefixes). Flights with unknown (ZZZZ) ends and same-airport circuits are excluded. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND NOT (f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home)
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular domestic routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 97. Top 10 departure-arrival pairs where both ends are in the home region. Same-airport circuits and ZZZZ are excluded. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular VFR routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 59. VFR flights (flight rules V) between two different airports, routes flown by at least 3 distinct pilots. Changed from v1: counts distinct CIDs (v1 counted callsigns) and drops the average ATC contact percentage, which depended on frequency matching. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots,
       count(*) AS flights,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average duration (min)",
       min(end_time) AS "First flight",
       max(end_time) AS "Latest flight"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.flight_rules = 'V'
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY route_label
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 3
ORDER BY pilots DESC, flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pilots with the most diverse routes (last 14 days)
panels.description: v1 card 46. Pilots ranked by number of distinct departure-arrival pairs, flights longer than 60 minutes only. Pilot name as shown on the network. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.name ORDER BY f.end_time DESC))[1] AS pilot,
       count(DISTINCT route_label) AS unique_routes,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.duration_minutes > 60
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.cid
ORDER BY unique_routes DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Busiest home-region airports (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 55. Departures and arrivals at home-region airports (from the movements view), top 10 by total movements. Departures are counted at flight start, arrivals at flight end. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT airport,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'departure') AS departures,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
FROM movements
WHERE movement_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, airport
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Quietest home-region airports (last 30 days)
panels.description: Screenshot-only chart ('Which airport had the least movements'). The 20 home-region airports with the fewest movements; every airport with at least one movement appears. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT airport,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'departure') AS departures,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals,
       count(*) AS total_movements
FROM movements
WHERE movement_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY total_movements, airport
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Most popular airlines (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 58. Callsign prefix (three letters followed by a digit, so private registrations such as VHABC are not counted as airlines) mapped to a name through the airline lookup. Top 10 by flights. Changed from v1, which took the first three characters of every callsign. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(airline_name, airline_prefix) AS airline,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND airline_prefix IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY airline_prefix, airline_name
ORDER BY flights DESC, pilots DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular callsigns (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 57. Callsign and route flown by at least 2 distinct pilots, top 10 by distinct pilots then flights. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, departure, arrival,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS unique_pilots,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY callsign, departure, arrival
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: v1 card 90. Flights per aircraft category from the aircraft_type lookup (codes not in the lookup are 'Other / uncategorised'). Changed from v1: categories come from a lookup table instead of a LIKE ladder that mis-classified many types. v1 card 90: flights per aircraft category over 6 months, flights with an aircraft type and airborne time only; categories come from the aircraft_type lookup (owner decision 08-10-2026), not v1 pattern ladder. v1 average-time-with-ATC column stays dropped (ADR-002). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY flights DESC

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by pilots (last 6 months)
panels.description: v1 card 135 (SQL re-checked 08-10-2026). Distinct pilots per aircraft category over the last 6 months, counting only flights with some airborne time and a filed aircraft type (v1: enroute minutes above 0, aircraft type not empty). Categories come from the aircraft_type lookup, not v1's LIKE ladder (open question for the owner). v1's average-time-with-ATC column is dropped (ATC matching is out of scope, ADR-002). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Highest groundspeeds (last 7 days)
panels.description: v1 card 61 (SQL re-checked 08-10-2026). Peak groundspeed per callsign (top 20) over the last 7 days. Flights need a destination, a peak above 100 kt and a highest altitude above 1000 ft. Excludes military (lookup), supersonic, business jets and turboprops (lookup) plus the v1 code list entries the lookup lacks, including the Embraer E-series; other regional jets are NOT excluded, as in v1. Changed from v1: uses the maximum groundspeed stored on the session (capped at 700 kt on ingest) and the highest altitude reached, not the altitude at the moment of peak speed. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, pilot, aircraft_icao AS aircraft, departure, arrival,
       max_gs_kt AS "Peak groundspeed (kt)", max_alt_ft AS "Highest altitude (ft)", end_time AS "Flight ended"
FROM (
  SELECT f.callsign, f.name AS pilot, f.aircraft_icao, f.departure, f.arrival, f.max_gs_kt, f.max_alt_ft, f.end_time,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.callsign ORDER BY f.max_gs_kt DESC, f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.max_gs_kt > 100 AND f.max_gs_kt <= 750
    AND f.max_alt_ft > 1000
    AND f.arrival IS NOT NULL AND f.arrival <> ''
    AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT f.is_military
    AND COALESCE(f.aircraft_category, '') NOT IN ('Supersonic', 'Business jet', 'Turboprop')
    AND f.aircraft_icao <> ALL (ARRAY['E135', 'E145', 'E170', 'E175', 'E190', 'E195',
         'F18H', 'VF35', 'BE90', 'GLF7', 'FAL7', 'FAL8', 'FAL9', 'FAL0',
         'AT42', 'DH8Q', 'PC21', 'EMB1', 'EMB2', 'EMB3', 'EMB4', 'EMB5'])
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIG%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIR%'
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'F-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'SU-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'TU-%'
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY max_gs_kt DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Busiest days by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: v1 card 128. The five UTC dates with the most flights (by flight start). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS flight_date,
       trim(to_char(f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, flight_date DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Busiest days by pilots online (last 6 months)
panels.description: v1 card 129 (SQL re-checked 08-10-2026). The ten UTC dates with the most distinct pilots, counted by the date the pilot logged on (v1 used the session logon date, not the flight start), over the last 6 months, with weekday and rank. Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS member_date,
       trim(to_char(f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(DISTINCT f.cid) DESC, (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date DESC) AS rank
FROM flight f
WHERE f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, member_date DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Flights with SELCAL in the remarks
panels.description: v1 card 103. Share of flights whose remarks contain 'SEL/', out of flights that have any remarks (same denominator as v1). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.has_selcal) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS "SELCAL (%)"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.has_remarks

panels.title: Which member spent the most time online? (last 7 days)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 155. Top 10 pilots with a Y-suffixed name by hours with airborne time (v1: enroute time) over the last 7 days, counting only flights with more than 30 minutes airborne. The v1 title says 'online' but the figure is airborne time, as in v1. Fixed 7-day window (not the time picker). Flights appear here about 8 hours after the flight ends.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table (see docs/t15_notes/a_pilots_people.md): one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
)
SELECT
    cid,
    name,
    ROUND(SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) / 60.0) AS total_enroute_hours
FROM flight_summaries
WHERE
    SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
    AND total_enroute_time_minutes > 30
    AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY cid, name
ORDER BY SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) DESC, cid
LIMIT 10
